## Purpose

What ClaimLens behavior or project requirement does this change address?

## Owner

Which architectural layer owns this change?

## Evidence / Baseline

What test, benchmark case, observed failure, or requirement justifies the change?

## Change

What is the smallest systemic change being made?

## Verification

What was run and what passed?

## Drift check

- [ ] This does not expand product scope without an explicit decision.
- [ ] AI has not absorbed deterministic billing policy.
- [ ] Claim evidence remains traceable.
- [ ] No real patient/PHI data, secrets, or credentials are included.
- [ ] New complexity is justified by a requirement or measured failure.
- [ ] `IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md` / `DECISIONS.md` were updated if needed.
